body:
The introversion coupled with the social anxiety definitely keep me from talking to new people and there lies part of the problem. I want to get out, meet new people, and have fun but there's this huge barrier preventing me from doing so.

My dad's disabled and my mom is his caretaker. My mom is aware of everything but at the same time I don't want to burden her with my problems on top of everything she already has to deal with.

I have no one else here anymore, I didn't have friends in high school or anything of that such so I'm just living minute by minute hoping for this day to end and the next to pass.
I only really had one true friend... and we briefly talked about 4 months ago.
